notes.title: Next Fest - Live Stream with the Dev
notes.content: [p]Next fest is here and so is Twisted Jam. I will be broadcasting throughout the week at various times. During the stream you can play and chat with me inside the game. [/p][p][/p][p][b]What time can you catch the stream?[/b] It will be various throughout the week. But mostly during the evening times.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Is there other ways to reach out?[/b] Yes, join our discord: [url="https://discord.gg/nM6JrNRJzq"]https://discord.gg/nM6JrNRJzq[/url][/p][p][/p]
